ambient_events: The chandelier overhead throws splinters of light across black marble.
The grand staircase sweeps up into shadow and down into a low mechanical thrum.
Your reflection follows you across the polished bulkheads, a half-step behind.
description: The boarding foyer of the Echelon: a double-height atrium in black marble and brushed titanium, lit by a single vast chandelier that costs more than most people will earn in a lifetime. A grand staircase sweeps UP to the cabin deck and DOWN to engineering. Forward (NORTH) lies the bridge; aft (SOUTH), the stern lounge. The gangway hatch leads OUT onto the water.
name: Echelon — Boarding Foyer
